The box Minkowski polynomial 8 prod_i(a_i+s) gives mixed volumes 3V(K,K,L)=8 sum_{i<j}a_i a_j, 3V(K,L,L)=8 sum_i a_i. Substituting t1=a_i,t2=a_j and t3=1/(t1t2)=a_k makes both B_3 conditions exact equalities. Weighted Cauchy–Schwarz proves the box with semiaxes sqrt(a_i) is inside the log-Wulff mean; coordinate supports give reverse inclusion, so M0 is exactly that box. M1 has semiaxes sqrt(a_i)*lambda_i with lambda_i=(sqrt(a_i)+1/sqrt(a_i))/2, making both proposed RHS equal 8sum_i lambda_i =3V(M0,M0,M1). Converse simultaneous equality reconstructs the same cubic symmetric coefficients, so its root multiset is {a_i}. Independently performed symbolic symmetric-polynomial identities and exact rational sample all-index consistency checks; those finite cases are supplementary to universal algebra.
